subject: organic
question: 有机化学·自由基极性：根据 Radical Learn 所采用的常见反应性分类，Difluoromethyl radical 通常主要表现为亲核型还是亲电型自由基？（回答该教材中的主要倾向，具体反应条件可能影响表现。）
explanation_en: Unlike •CF₃, •CF₂H reacts as a nucleophile with heteroarenes: it attacks protonated, electron-poor positions as alkyl radicals do in Minisci reactions.
